name: Shaken Creek Farms
tagline: Shaken Creek Farms, 687 Pinkney Road, Burgaw, NC (2026)
description: In Burgaw, NC, Shaken Creek Farms raises Blueberries and Honey on a independent farm. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. Visitors can find seasonal produce and farm-grown goods through summer. Check the website or call ahead for current hours and what is in season.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Jun – Aug in this growing zone.
